timed_text.text: Day 23. Commitment: directing your behavior toward your values, every day.
The most powerful way to stay anchored to your values: make them visible.
Build a picture of the athlete you're becoming — see it every day.
Repeated exposure to a desired image changes what the brain prioritizes.
Your attention starts to organize around what you see consistently.
What you see consistently, you move toward.
This only works if it's real — specific goals, your why, your identity.
Use Canva, use images, use words — build something that pulls you.
On your screen, you'll find the visualization board tool.

blocks.prompt: Build a picture of the athlete you're committing to becoming. Your goals. Your why. Your future. Make it specific enough that looking at it every day means something.

timed_text.text: That board lives on your home screen now.
Look at it every morning before you train.
Look at it the night before competition.
Look at it when the work gets hard and the results aren't showing up yet.
After you finish, day 23 is complete.
